name: Facecard: Makeup Showdown [⭐UPD]
desc:
💄Have you ever wanted to achieve a LETHAL facecard?💅

In Facecard: Makeup Showdown you can be a makeup artist and use various tools, brushes and makeup to perfect your dream look and slay the competition! 💋💄🪞

✨Vote for the best makeup look
🎨OR you can take your time in freeplay
💁‍♀️Use various hairs, lashes or rhinestones to complete your look

Are you ready to take on the beauty world? 3, 2, 1... May the best facecard win!
